subject.title: Feature: Expose OpenRouter usage cost to agent runtime

question: Should exact provider-reported cost be added to session_status/runtime metadata, exposed through a dedicated usage tool, or remain operator-only accounting?
rationale: Current main has the underlying exact OpenRouter accounting signal, but the repository has several overlapping usage surfaces and no confirmed public agent-facing contract or fallback semantics.

options.title: Extend session_status
options.body: Add source-tagged exact last-turn and cumulative billed cost to the existing agent-callable status surface, with clearly labeled estimates only when exact cost is unavailable.

options.title: Add usage tool
options.body: Create a dedicated detailed usage API and keep session_status concise, accepting another public agent-runtime surface.

options.title: Keep operator-only
options.body: Retain exact billed cost in transcript and operator reporting without exposing it to agents or channel renderers.

recommendation.title: Extend session_status
recommendation.body: Add source-tagged exact last-turn and cumulative billed cost to the existing agent-callable status surface, with clearly labeled estimates only when exact cost is unavailable.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest available history spans the provider transport, session persistence, runtime metadata, and status boundary involved in this choice.
